news_1_body:
At the recently concluded Asia Food Expo 2026 in Bangkok, Thailand, YuKoLi made a stunning debut with its all-new 5th generation smart cooking robot, becoming the center of attention throughout the event. The expo attracted over 2,000 foodservice companies from Southeast Asia, South Asia, and the Middle East.

The 5th generation smart cooking robot represents a comprehensive upgrade over its predecessors, featuring an all-new AI cooking engine that supports over 800 recipes spanning Chinese, Southeast Asian, and Western cuisines. Equipped with a precision temperature control system and adaptive stir-frying technology, the device achieves a cooking consistency rate of 99.5%, far exceeding the industry average.

The YuKoLi booth was bustling throughout the expo, with representatives from over 200 restaurant brands across Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, and Indonesia experiencing the device firsthand. Multiple restaurant chain groups expressed partnership intentions on the spot, with the first batch of 50 units expected to be delivered and deployed within six months.

YuKoLi CEO stated in a media interview: "Our goal is not just to provide a smart device, but to create a complete intelligent kitchen solution for foodservice businesses. Through the deep integration of AI technology and IoT platforms, YuKoLi helps clients achieve standardization and automation across the entire workflow from prep to plating, significantly reducing labor costs while ensuring the high quality and consistency of every dish."

Additionally, YuKoLi unveiled its new cloud management platform at the expo, supporting remote equipment monitoring, automated maintenance alerts, and one-click recipe updates, further enhancing operational efficiency and intelligence in commercial kitchens.
news_2_body:
A leading Southeast Asian restaurant chain has announced the large-scale deployment of YuKoLi automated cooking lines across all 86 outlets, marking a milestone in the commercialization of kitchen automation in the region. The project represents a total investment exceeding USD 12 million, the largest single order in YuKoLi's Southeast Asian market history.

The chain operates three major business segments — quick service, casual dining, and fine dining — across Thailand, Vietnam, and Cambodia. With the introduction of YuKoLi automated cooking lines, the brand has achieved fully automated production from ingredient preparation and automatic cooking to finished product packaging at its central kitchens, increasing daily meal output per outlet by 3x while reducing labor costs by 65%.

The project is being rolled out in three phases: Phase 1 involves equipment installation and commissioning at 30 flagship stores, Phase 2 covers the remaining 56 outlets, and Phase 3 will launch the YuKoLi cloud management platform for unified scheduling and data analytics across the entire network.

The chain's Operations Director commented: "YuKoLi's equipment has performed exceptionally well during the trial period. The high consistency in food quality has significantly boosted customer satisfaction. More importantly, the YuKoLi team provided comprehensive after-sales service and technical support, giving us complete confidence throughout the deployment process."

YuKoLi's Southeast Asia Regional Director revealed that the successful implementation of this project has laid a solid foundation for the company's expansion across the region. Multiple restaurant companies from various countries are currently in discussions for similar large-scale automation projects, with another wave of orders expected in the second half of 2026.
news_3_body:
Following a rigorous six-month audit and on-site inspection process, all YuKoLi products have successfully achieved ISO 9001:2015 international quality management system certification and European Union CE safety compliance certification, marking a significant milestone in the company's quality control and international market access capabilities.

The ISO 9001:2015 certification requires companies to meet international standards across all aspects of quality management, including R&D design, manufacturing, supply chain management, and after-sales service. The auditing body gave high praise to YuKoLi's quality management system, particularly recognizing the company's rigorous approach to raw material traceability, standardized production process controls, and pre-delivery product inspections.

The CE certification is a mandatory market access requirement for the European Union, involving strict testing across multiple dimensions including electrical safety, mechanical safety, and electromagnetic compatibility. All YuKoLi smart cooking equipment successfully passed every test category, demonstrating that the products have achieved world-class standards in safety and reliability.

YuKoLi's Quality Management Director stated: "Obtaining dual certification is an important achievement of our long-standing quality-first strategy. We have invested substantial resources in building our quality management system, with strict standards and procedures at every step from supplier screening to final product delivery. These certifications are not only a recognition of our existing work but also a driving force for continuous improvement."

YuKoLi is currently advancing applications for US UL certification and Japan JIS certification, expected to be completed by the end of 2026. Upon completion, the company will have a comprehensive certification system covering all major global markets, providing strong support for further international market expansion.
